own_solution.law: de Broglie lambda = h/p with non-relativistic p = sqrt(2 m K), so lambda = hc / sqrt(2 mc^2 K)
assumptions: starts from rest so total KE equals energy gained (stated)

defect_reasons.other: TF42A, T3B16, TD0E0 and TCF3D refer to 'the proton' / 'the alpha particle' with a definite article although the problem only says the second apparatus accelerates protons and alpha particles (plural); minor wording.

notes: Base: sqrt(2 x 511000 eV x 150 eV) = sqrt(1.533e8) = 12381.4 eV; lambda = 1240/12381.4 = 0.10015 nm. With 150 + 90 = 240 eV: sqrt(2.4528e8) = 15661.4 eV; lambda = 1240/15661.4 = 0.07918 nm. Both energies are far below 511 keV, so the non-relativistic treatment is fine. The proton and alpha sentences concern particles in a separate apparatus: D. Numbered variants all state 90 eV; T3B16 and TD0E0 are numeral-free versions.
